latest.title: Sharp Dispersive and Strichartz Estimates for the Neumann Cylindrical Wave Model
latest.abstract: We establish local-in-time dispersive and sharp Strichartz estimates for the linear wave equation with Neumann boundary conditions inside a cylindrical convex domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^3$ featuring a non-empty smooth boundary $\partialΩ$. The cylindrical geometry dictates that the nonnegative radius of curvature vanishes along the axial direction. By utilizing an explicit spectral analysis based on the zeros of the Airy function derivative, alongside a tailored Airy--Poisson summation formula, we capture the microlocal behavior of multi-reflected waves and caustics. Finally, we apply these sharp Strichartz estimates without loss of derivatives to prove local well-posedness and small-data global well-posedness for the energy-critical quintic nonlinear wave equation (NLW) subject to Neumann boundary conditions.
latest.workSummary: 研究矩形域 Neumann 波方程的全局与局部色散界、可容许 Strichartz 对及五次能量临界问题的适定性与散射。
latest.breakthrough: Theorems 1–3 从 Neumann 色散估计推进到能量临界波方程的全局适定性和散射。
latest.limitations: 域几何、Neumann 边界及能量临界非线性是必要框架；色散估计按切向/法向频区分段。

steps.claim: Theorem 1 给出全局和局部 Neumann 色散界。
steps.route: 用 Green function 与本征模表示，按频率和切向方向分区并控制法向通量。
steps.evidence: PDF 第5–7页，第1节 Theorem 1；PDF 第10–18页，第3.1节 Proposition 7、Lemma 8。

steps.claim: Theorems 4–6 建立主要半经典频区的局部估计。
steps.route: 对 $a\le h^{3(1-\epsilon )}$ 与 $a\ge h^{3(1-\epsilon )}$ 分别使用 Airy–Poisson 求和、驻相和几何基数估计。
steps.evidence: PDF 第12–18页，第3.1节 Theorems 4–6；PDF 第25–31页，第3.3节 Theorem 11、Lemmas 12–13。

steps.claim: Theorem 3 由色散界和 Strichartz 理论推出临界全局适定性与散射。
steps.route: 先从 Theorem 1/2 获得 admissible Strichartz 对，再用能量守恒、局部理论和小数据/迭代论证完成全局延拓。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–5页，第1节 Theorem 3；PDF 第约40页以后关于 energy-critical well-posedness/scattering 的收束段。
